name: ENCORP
recent: Encorp 近期获得 Felda 价值 RM16.96mil 的员工住房合约，并签署了谅解备忘录。最新季度（2026年9月30日止）营收同比下滑45.8%，净亏损扩大至RM6.36m。此外，公司风险委员会成员及首席官员出现人事变动。
notable: 子公司获得 Felda 价值 RM16.96mil 的员工住房合约。
公司与多方签署谅解备忘录（分别于2026年9月30日、10月21日及11月25日公告）。
2026年第三季度业绩：营收同比下滑45.8%，净亏损RM6.36m。
risks: 最新季度净亏损扩大至RM6.36m，营收同比下滑45.8%。
风险委员会成员及首席官员出现变动。
earnings: 2026年第三季度（截至9月30日）营收同比下滑45.8%，净亏损扩大至RM6.36m。上一季度（截至6月30日）营收环比增长144.9%，净亏损为RM2.348m，净利率为-6.9%。

recent_en: Encorp recently secured a RM16.96mil staff housing contract from Felda and entered into a memorandum of understanding. For the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue fell 45.8% year-on-year and net loss widened to RM6.36m. There were also changes in risk committee members and principal officer.
notable_en: Subsidiary secured a RM16.96mil staff housing contract from Felda.
The company entered into memoranda of understanding (announced on 30 Sep, 21 Oct and 25 Nov 2026).
Q3 2026 results: revenue fell 45.8% year-on-year, net loss of RM6.36m.
risks_en: Latest quarter net loss widened to RM6.36m with revenue down 45.8% year-on-year.
Changes in risk committee members and principal officer.
earnings_en: Q3 2026 (ended 30 Sep) revenue fell 45.8% year-on-year and net loss widened to RM6.36m. In the prior quarter (ended 30 Jun), revenue rose 144.9% quarter-on-quarter, net loss was RM2.348m with a net margin of -6.9%.
